_what: The instruction and skill files other AIs keep on this Mac that the person can bring into Trillion as saved instructions (read-data/ai-setups.mjs, tool:read-ai-setups). Each `sources` row is a place: `files` are single files, `folder` lists a folder's entries (those ending in one of `endings`, or a folder holding `entry`). `kind` says what it is (instructions, command or skill). Reading goes through read-data/file-arguments.mjs, so its roots and protected names apply. Nothing is written to those places. A new AI is one more row.
